name: Meganeya
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional eyeglasses shop: a regular-closing-day notice, a first day helping at the shop, a price-plan guide, a free eye-check consultation notice, a new-staff training plan comparison, a story about noticing a repeat customer's change through good service, a lesson teaching a new part-timer the basics of frame adjustment, an explainer on why the shop still uses an old hand-operated lens grinder, a free adjustment-service application guide, a column on how online glasses sales changed the shop's work, a new-school-term reservation rule new standard, a column on the meaning of a craftsman's skill for judging a face for frame fit, and a one-year neighboring-opticians-association cooperation report. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
